title: The Seventh Voice
summary: Whoever sang the drowned up off the Mole is in Highmarch: Lucan Varro, who signs himself Lucanus, the Seventh Voice. Hester Quaile wants the company through his walls and into his palace.

steps.journal: Take the Highmarch road north off the coast road to Highmarch's gate, and go into the dungeon. The Seventh's Champion holds the walls' great bastion.
Go down to the dungeon's second floor, the Seventh's Palace. Lucan Varro is in the throne room at its end. Beat him.
Lucan is beaten and has sat down on the throne room's steps. Talk to him there before he goes.

ready: Lucan read the Kindler's letters and walked north after him. Go back to Hester Quaile at the Paid Toll in Tollhaven.
done: Lucan walked north after the vessel, which left with the Kindler days ago. The Pilgrims' Stair is open. Act IV is done.
